## Shipped Products & AI Architectures
- [WriteFrankly](https://writefrankly.ai.studio/): Private journaling companion for unvarnished reflection without performance or fear of consequence. Built with dynamic Gemini API dialogue flows, in-RAM PII masking, Web Crypto AES-GCM 256-bit encryption at rest, and instant onboarding on Cloud Run with zero data loss.
- [MakanSini 2.0](https://github.com/4ranklyn/MakanSiniv2): Cross-platform culinary intelligence MVP shipping in 7 days. Integrated Gemini and Google Places APIs on Cloud Run with strict prompt-injection defenses and sub-400ms p95 latency; presented live at Google I/O 2026 (Mountain View) as student global marketing pitch champion.
- [VeraGate](https://github.com/4ranklyn/veragate): Autonomous multimodal forensic audit engine leveraging Gemini 3 (Watcher & Auditor dual-agent architecture) to detect spatial, temporal, and specification contradictions between video evidence and technical PDF documentation via Server-Sent Events.
- [CeKulit](https://github.com/4ranklyn/cekulit-ml): Cross-functional AI skin diagnostic MVP engineered with TensorFlow CNN models (84%+ accuracy) deployed to Cloud Flask API with sub-$1/day operational COGS (92.5/100 capstone jury score).
